_comment: Hand-maintained entries merged into public/firmware-manifest.json by scripts/generate-firmware-manifest.mjs (extra wins on id clash). Use for devices whose firmware Logitech only ships outside versioned depots, or values confirmed against vendor software. Prefer generated entries whenever a depot exists. Versions here are in device-reported (entity) numbering, e.g. HID++ MPM 38.00, which G HUB displays as package 38.0.5 — see releaseNotes.

devices.releaseNotes: Entity MPM 38.00 == package 38.0.5, confirmed current in G HUB on 2026-10-09.
Resolves cursor tracking issues in the system BIOS and fixes abnormal behavior when playing Valorant with Anti-Cheat Expert (ACE) enabled.
